policy: Frozen release of generic tools, runtime and demonstration bots. Competitive bots, learned models, training, private results and infrastructure are excluded. Historical article examples retain their existing provenance.

release_adaptations.documentation: Document the public commands and released scope.
release_adaptations.flake.nix, justfile, .envrc: Pin the development environment and expose public build/run stages with repository-local storage, without private infrastructure or mounts.
release_adaptations.tools/commands/build.just: Select the current runtime entry point while retaining compatibility with historical article bots.
release_adaptations.tools/engine: Extract generic game rules, turn protocol and engine ABI. Exclude competitive policy, belief and training interfaces. Relocate includes and retain a standalone CPU/CUDA build and batch shim.
release_adaptations.tools/evaluation: Run locally, disable cloud runners, use random as the released baseline and include staged source headers when compiling historical examples.
release_adaptations.tools/ladder: Require an explicit own-team ID for public replay collection; use local storage defaults and the released engine header for map fitting.
release_adaptations.tools/viewer: Use the public replay launcher and local build commands; omit private URL handlers.
